visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a blue scoop-neck top and black pants, sits in an office chair. She smiles broadly, looking directly at the camera, and gestures expressively with both hands while holding a gold-colored laptop on her lap. The background is a brightly lit office with shelves filled with colorful items, computer monitors, and other colleagues working at their desks. (2) She opens the laptop to demonstrate a Chrome extension named 'PauseBuy'. The camera focuses on the screen, showing a clean user interface with input fields for monthly salary, daily work hours, and monthly expenses. Her hand is seen pointing at the laptop screen while she continues to explain the tool's features with a friendly facial expression. (3) The video transitions to a screen capture of a shopping website displaying a Nintendo Switch console. A bold red text overlay, generated by the extension, appears over the product's price, stating that it would take 11 days of work to afford it. The woman is shown in a small picture-in-picture inset, reacting with an impressed look. (4) She navigates to another product, a pack of tissues, on the PChome website. The extension calculates that it takes 4 hours of work to buy them. She points at the screen with a playful smirk. A male colleague's arm briefly enters the frame from the right side, pointing at the screen as he speaks an off-camera line. (5) The woman returns to full frame, looking at the camera with a humorous, exaggerated pouting expression. She gives a thumbs-up while a small cartoon blue tear and falling leaf overlays appear around her to emphasize a mock-tragic tone about her salary. The office background remains clearly visible and well-lit as the video ends.
